svg.title: Home-made oral rehydration solution (ORS): 1 litre safe water + 6 level teaspoons sugar + half a level teaspoon salt
svg.text: 1 L safe water + 6 level teaspoons sugar + ½ level teaspoon salt
Oral rehydration solution · WHO / UNICEF home recipe · Saves children from diarrhoea
